description: Verify that TCP sends a RST after receiving an unacceptable ACK in SYN-RCVD (RFC 793 §3.4 p35)
approach:
[Objective]
In SYN-RCVD, an ACK whose ack_num is not the expected SYN+1 is bogus — DUT replies with RST to abort the bad attempt.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in SYN-RCVD after receiving tester SYN.
2. Tester → DUT: ACK with unacceptable ack_num.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST.

[Pass condition]
DUT RST observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout — no DUT RST

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied RST to unacceptable ACK in SYN-RCVD — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT RST to unacceptable ACK in SYN-RCVD
